title: Conservation of Momentum - Collision
body: A trolley A of mass 4 kg moving at 6 m/s to the right collides with trolley B of mass 2 kg moving at 3 m/s to the left. After the collision, they stick together and move as one object. Taking rightward as positive, calculate: (a) the total momentum before the collision, and (b) the velocity of the combined trolleys after the collision.
oer: Siyavula Physical Sciences Grade 12 - Momentum and Impulse
